text: 灵枢 Lingshu（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DSH 增加持久认知图记忆与会话续接。插件启动随包提供的 md_cg MCP 服务，并把 cg/stg 及可选细粒度工具注册到 DSH。它能把用户消息沉淀为带会话归属的记忆、在请求时自动召回相关记忆、维护独立的近期对话窗口，并提供工具供 agent 查询和更新记忆。适合希望跨轮保留知识并恢复近期对话的 DSH Web 用户。写入可用首启签发凭据；记忆根目录可配置。

Lingshu adds persistent memory to DSH Web through bundled md_cg MCP. It registers cg/stg tools, stores user messages by session, recalls relevant memories during prompt assembly, and keeps a separate recent-conversation window. Agents can query or update memory, and its data root is configurable.

灵枢的功能「自动记忆」：把真实用户消息脱敏后写入认知图，并附上会话归属、角色与重要度。由 DSH 会话事件触发。
灵枢的功能「自动召回」：在 system prompt 组装时读取当前会话的近期记忆并注入上下文；可选注入身份锚点。
灵枢的功能「近期对话窗口」：将用户和助手消息追加到独立滚动窗口，并在请求组装时按条数和预算取回。
灵枢的功能「认知图工具」：按配置向 DSH 注册 cg、stg 基元或更完整的 MCP 工具集，让 agent 查询和维护记忆。
灵枢的功能「记忆筛选写入」：自动记忆通过 gated 写入，经 ACCEPT、MERGE、DROP 或 DEFER 处理后记录结果。
灵枢的功能「跨会话时间线」：使用 stg 时间线读取带时间区间的记忆，并按当前会话筛选自动召回内容。
灵枢使用前须知：没有可用写入凭据时，认知图以只读 guest 运行，自动记忆等写入不会落盘；插件会尝试解析或首启签发凭据。（见 src/index.ts:290-310）

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · 🧭 身份事实写在哪（issue #635）：**self / anchor 层默认不参与自动召回**——它们是永久层，按需用 mdcg_recall / stg 显式取。
如果你希望模型「一开口就知道自己是谁」，有四种落地方式：

| 方式 | 做法 | 适用 |
|---|---|---|
| ① 开身份块 | memory.autoRecallIdentity: true（0.9.12 起） | 想留在记忆层、又要自动注入 |
| ② 换层 | 把身份事实写进 structural / knowledge 层 | 不需要改配置 |
| ③ 宿主兜底 | 写进 AGENTS.md / persona 配置 | 升级不会丢，但不属于记忆层 |
| ④ 显式召回 | 需要时调 mdcg_recall / stg(op=timeline) | 完全可控，不占系统提示词预算 |

开 ① 后注入的是独立块【灵枢身份锚点】：最多 3 条、单条 160 字符、整块 640 字符，
不占「最近记忆」块的预算，且与其它注入面一样过不可信边界标记与脱敏。

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · ⏱️ 长会话提醒（每 10 个真实用户回合）：插件会在长会话里提醒做间歇归档（工作纪律第 16 条）。计轮单位是**真实用户回合**（用户消息条数），
不是模型请求次数——一次请求内部会触发多次 system-prompt 组装，按组装次数计会把"每 10 轮"退化成"每一步"。

| 配置 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| memory.turnReminder: 10（默认） | 每 10 个用户回合提醒一次，**只出现一步** |
| memory.turnReminder: N | 自定义间隔（1~100） |
| memory.turnReminder: false | 整条关闭 |

提醒只在命中那一步注入、下一步即消失（接受两份快照的代价），不会常驻上下文，
也不会因并行会话共用一个计数器而放大频率（无会话标识时不提醒）。
section: ⏱️ 长会话提醒（每 10 个真实用户回合）

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · ✨ 核心亮点：- **🧠 不失忆**——落盘即长期留存，遗忘只能显式发起、不做静默淘汰；检索索引只是派生物，**原文即真源**
- **⚡ 高性能**——Rust 检索内核（零第三方依赖）＋ `--serve` 进程实例支撑多智能体并发。公开基准 [hive-memory-bench](https://github.com/FuRongJun-1999/hive-memory-bench) 六家同口径：**逐字保真 100% · 保地基 68.4%/65.0% · 证据链 97–100% · 写入 0.013–0.020 秒（零 LLM，同表其余 75.7–658.5 秒）**
- **🛡️ 无幻觉**——记什么、取什么、能不能写入全部由确定性规则裁决，不依赖 LLM 黑箱；写没写成功只看 `committed`，绝不假装通过
- **🔌 多智能体适用**——同一份大脑 + 同一份纪律，接入 DSH · CodeBuddy · ZCode · Codex CLI · Claude Code，任何 MCP 宿主可直接挂载
- **📊 可复现评测**——权威对照在独立公开基准 hive-memory-bench；另公开两个自建题池；**已有两份第三方独立验证**（七轮复评 + LoCoMo 独立复现，自报数字逐位一致）

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · 🧰 工具面：> **会话隔离的可选依赖**：稳定会话身份（`s5.*`）由 `session5_resolve()` 从 **DSH** 会话文件推导（**仅 DSH 端**），
> **需自备 `pip install zstandard`**（本仓库不声明、CI 不代装）。未装 ⇒ 该函数返回 None 并把原因写进 `reason`，
> 调用方拿不到稳定身份（同一会话不同进程可能算出不同 id ⇒ 跨会话写入错标）。
>
> ⚠ **不崩 ≠ 能用**：进程照跑、记忆照写，但**会话隔离这项能力不可用**。装了也不保证成功——
> 另有 8 种 reason（`not_uuid_form` / `sessions_root_not_found` / `session_file_not_found` / 等），排查先读 `reason`。

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · 🧭 Where identity facts are written (issue #635)：**The self / anchor layers do not take part in automatic recall by default** - they are permanent layers, fetched explicitly on demand with mdcg_recall / stg.
If you want the model to "know who it is from the first sentence", there are four ways to land it:

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · 🧭 Where identity facts are written (issue #635)：| Approach | How | Fits |
|---|---|---|
| ① Enable the identity block | memory.autoRecallIdentity: true (since 0.9.12) | You want it in the memory layer and injected automatically |
| ② Change layer | Write identity facts into the structural / knowledge layer | No config change needed |
| ③ Host fallback | Write into AGENTS.md / persona config | Survives upgrades, but is not part of the memory layer |
| ④ Explicit recall | Call mdcg_recall / stg(op=timeline) when needed | Fully controllable, no system prompt budget |

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · 🧭 Where identity facts are written (issue #635)：With ① on, the injected block is a separate block [LINGSHU identity anchor]: at most 3 entries, 160 characters per entry, 640 characters for the whole block,
it does not consume the "recent memory" block budget, and like every other injection surface it passes untrusted-boundary markers and redaction.

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · ⏱️ Long-session reminder (every 10 real user turns)：The plugin reminds you to archive intermittently in long sessions (Engineering Discipline item 16). The counting unit is **real user turns** (the number of user messages),
not model request count - a single request triggers several system-prompt assemblies, and counting assemblies would degrade "every 10 turns" into "every step".

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · ⏱️ Long-session reminder (every 10 real user turns)：| Config | Behavior |
|---|---|
| memory.turnReminder: 10 (default) | Remind once every 10 user turns, **appears for one step only** |
| memory.turnReminder: N | Custom interval (1~100) |
| memory.turnReminder: false | Turn the whole thing off |

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · ⏱️ Long-session reminder (every 10 real user turns)：The reminder is injected only on the step that hits it and disappears on the next step (accepting the cost of two snapshots). It does not stay in context,
and it is not amplified when parallel sessions share one counter (no reminder when there is no session identity).

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · ✨ Highlights：- **🧠 Never forgets** - what is persisted stays long term; forgetting must be started explicitly and there is no silent eviction; the retrieval index is a derivative only, **the source text is the source of truth**
- **⚡ High performance** - a Rust retrieval core (zero third-party dependencies) plus `--serve` process instances for multi-agent concurrency. The public benchmark [hive-memory-bench](https://github.com/FuRongJun-1999/hive-memory-bench) compares six systems under one measurement basis: **verbatim fidelity 100% · foundation retention 68.4%/65.0% · evidence chain 97-100% · write 0.013-0.020 s (zero LLM, versus 75.7-658.5 s for the rest of the table)**
- **🛡️ No hallucination** - what is recorded, what is recalled, and whether a write is allowed are all adjudicated by deterministic rules, with no LLM black box; whether a write succeeded is judged only by `committed`, and success is never faked
- **🔌 Multi-agent ready** - one brain plus one discipline, mounted in DSH · CodeBuddy · ZCode · Codex CLI · Claude Code; any MCP host can mount it directly
- **📊 Reproducible evaluation** - the authoritative comparison lives in the indep

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · 🧰 Tool surface：> **Optional dependency for session isolation**: the stable session identity (`s5.*`) is derived by `session5_resolve()` from **DSH** session files (**DSH only**),
> and **you must install `pip install zstandard` yourself** (this repository does not declare it and CI does not install it). If missing ⇒ the function returns None and writes the reason into `reason`,
> so the caller gets no stable identity (different processes of the same session may compute different ids ⇒ cross-session writes are mislabeled).
>
> ⚠ **Not crashing is not the same as working**: the process keeps running and memory keeps being written, but **the session isolation capability is unavailable**. Installing it does not guarantee success either -
> there are 8 more reasons (`not_uuid_form` / `sessions_root_not_found` / `session_file_not_found` / etc.); read `reason` first when troubleshooting.

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · 🧰 Tool surface：**`tools` mode**: `'core'` (default · 2 tools) | `'brain'` / `'all'` (30 tools). @furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · 🔐 Permissions: read / write / adjudicate, three layers, each narrowable on its own：Writes tighten by layer: `contextual` can be written directly → `knowledge` needs a reflection unit → `structural` needs reflection + verification → `self`/`anchor` needs human adjudication (`MDCG_WRITE_GATE` three states: `off`/`warn`/`enforce`). Adjudication requires **dual-unit review and must not be self-certified** (`MDCG_REVIEW_DUAL_CHECK=1`). In `warn` mode, query the verdict with **`cg(op=info).write_gate`** (in-process counters, independent of the host forwarding stderr) - observe first, then switch to `enforce`.
Full rules, switches, and error reference → [Permissions and review model](docs/en/ops/permissions-review.md).

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · 🤝 Contribution and verification culture：**Submissions that are "verified to work" are especially welcome**: for issues, give the trigger condition, a minimal reproduction, and measured readings; for pull requests, attach a change description and how you verified it (re-run commands and readings); conclusions count only when they are **independently re-runnable** - [issue #1](https://github.com/FuRongJun-1999/lingshu/issues/1) is a good example (trigger chain, minimal reproduction, and criteria all present). For descriptions that lack evidence and cannot be reproduced, we reply asking for evidence first, then act.

@furongjun1999/dsh-memory README · 📏 Engineering Discipline and Designer Perspective (optional reuse)：> LINGSHU itself runs on **18 items of engineering discipline** (theory first / handle everything / root-cause discipline / verification first / dual-copy sync / fallback paths / task dispatch always through the hive / dual content-policy lists / sensitive information isolation / memory closed loop). These were originally LINGSHU's own "self-constraint" and have nothing to do with whether you use LINGSHU; but if you want your own agent to work the same way, this discipline **can be reused directly** - [discipline source of truth](docs/工作纪律_认知图条目_v1.1.json) (each item ≡ one cognitive map node, with trigger-word routing) · [designer perspective meta-skill](skills/skills/designer-perspective/) (before acting, answer "should this be done / why do it / are the conditions sufficient"). Some clauses target LINGSHU-private pipelines; when reusing, take only the five general groups: methodology / execution / scheduling / compliance / memory closed loop.
